messages:
kai: Quick RFC follow-up: I prototyped a hybrid 'stripe-overlay' loader that treats shards as independent stripes + supports delta overlays and progressive verification. Want feedback on atomicity and memory accounting.
alyssa: Sketch please.
kai: High level: base manifest lists shard->stripe layout. Overlays are thin manifests that reference changed stripe ranges. Loader composes overlays atomically at manifest switch time.
ram: If an overlay lands mid-prefetch, how do we avoid mixing versions in memory?
kai: We pin manifest_version per activation. Prefetch that sees a newer overlay will abort and restart against the pinned version. We also expose snapshot_epoch() for callers that need consistent views.
marie: Verification model? Streaming public sources mean CRCs only for fast checks, full sig verify async. If async fails we evict the stripe and emit an alert.
ishaan: Add short 64-bit fingerprints per stripe for fast rejects. Full SHA256/signature done off-path. Optionally support strict mode to block mapping until full verify completes.
alyssa: Memory/backpressure concerns: async verify + prefetch can bloat slab. How to throttle?
kai: Use a stripe_token_pool bounded by volatile_memory_budget and max_pending_stripes. Prefetch obtains tokens; if exhausted we pause prefetch. Also allow backpressure signals from the eviction thread.
ram: Upload strategies differ by stripe type (quantized vs fused). Can we put upload_hint in stripe metadata?
kai: Yes: hint: mmap|staged|direct. Loader honors hints when budget allows, otherwise falls back to staging.
marie: Hotpatch rollback? If overlay corrupt, revert to previous manifest_version and emit rollback event with telemetry.
ishaan: Implement atomic overlay apply via CAS on manifest pointer and keep previous manifest cached for quick rollback. Also record overlay_apply_failures metric.
alyssa: Runtime API proposal: ModelLoader.open(manifest_ref) -> ModelHandle; ModelHandle.open_stripe(stripe_id) -> StripeStream with read_slice, pin_to_gpu, verify_sync. ModelHandle.snapshot_epoch() available.
ram: Metrics: stripe_fetch_latency, stripe_verify_failures, overlay_apply_failures, prefetch_throttled_count, progressive_verify_block_count. Add alerts for verify_failures > threshold.
marie: Rollout: dedicated canary first, streaming public opt-in. Monitor verify_failures and evictions for 14 days.
devbot: CI job created: delta/stripe-integration (queued).
kai: Action items: kai -> push PoC branch by Thu; ishaan -> verifier microbench by Fri; alyssa -> unit tests for snapshot_epoch by Mon; ram -> wire metrics and console charts; marie -> draft rollback runbook.
kai: I'll open the PR and link tests here. Ping for pairing on verifier.
marie: :thumbsup:
